revenue.source: Sales and other operating revenue; FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000034088-26-000045) and 2025 Annual Report; excludes equity income and other income

operating_income.source: Derived: income before income taxes (52,783/48,873/41,268) + interest expense (849/996/603), FY2025 10-K acc. 0000034088-26-000045. Includes equity-affiliate income; XOM reports no operating income line

d_and_a.source: Depreciation and depletion (includes impairments), FY2025 10-K acc. 0000034088-26-000045

capex.source: Additions to property, plant and equipment (cash flow statement): FY2025 from 4Q25 earnings release (acc. 0000034088-26-000033); FY2024/FY2023 from 2024 Annual Report. Excludes acquisitions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 slightly down on lower crude price/divestments (FY2025 revenue fell 4.5%); then ~2% growth from Permian/Guyana volume growth offset by flat price deck

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: between FY2025 12.9% and 3-yr avg ~13.9% (derived EBIT/revenue); modestly conservative given weaker crude realizations

tax_rate.source: FY2025 effective rate: income tax 11,504 / pretax 41,268 = 27.9% (10-K acc. 0000034088-26-000045)

capex_pct_revenue.source: Company 2026 cash capex guidance $27-29bn (4Q25 release) vs ~$320bn revenue ≈ 8.8%

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap integrated oil, beta ~0.9, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5%, low leverage (debt/cap 14%); not from a data provider

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: roughly long-run inflation, below nominal GDP, given energy-transition uncertainty

net_debt.source: Total debt 43,537 (FY2025 Annual Report) less cash and equivalents ~10,700 (4Q25 release: $10.7bn, rounded, excl. restricted cash); no short-term investments found

diluted_shares.source: Average shares assuming dilution, full-year 2025 (millions), 4Q25 earnings release acc. 0000034088-26-000033
